'''Boltallion''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Voltmare]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Surprisingly, an even fiercer look came along with new friends. At top speed, Bolatllion's rippling mane generates powerful shockwaves that send dusty Zobos flying. The sound of cheers isn't far behind."

Boltallion is a Rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
Similar to [[Voltmare]], Boltallion is a slender, purple unicorn with bright orange and yellow accents. It has a sharp orange horn, orange hooves with lightning coming off the sides, and a spiky bolt-shaped mane and tail. It maintains an angered expression. 

Boltallion's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow-orange with green-blue.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "At full sprint, Boltallion's fur crackles with an intense electricity that can tear arcs through the very air. Fully charged attacks can instantly knock down an elite Zobo."

==Strategy==
[[File:Boltallion Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Boltallion's attack range]]
One of the best Lightning DPS, best placed in all Water lanes to get the most out of its splash ability. Its attack speed boost can be helpful to clear a lane as well.
